# uzc_network_acl_list (Resource)

Manages a network ACL list of a UzCloud VPC. Add rules with `uzc_network_acl_rule` and apply the list to a VPC tier with the `acl_id` attribute of `uzc_network`. Every VPC also has the built-in lists `default_allow` and `default_deny`. There is no update endpoint, so changing any attribute recreates the list. The resource ID is "{vpc}/{acl_id}".

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "uzc_network_acl_list" "app" {
  vpc         = uzc_vpc.example.slug
  name        = "app"
  description = "Rules for the app tier"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the list.
- `vpc` (String) Slug of the uzc_vpc the list belongs to.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description of the list.

### Read-Only

- `acl_id` (String) Server-assigned list id, for `acl_list_id` of `uzc_network_acl_rule` and `acl_id` of `uzc_network`.
- `id` (String) "{vpc}/{acl_id}". Used for import.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import uzc_network_acl_list.app <vpc-slug>/<acl-id>
```
